https://telex.hu/g7/podcast/2026/09/05/d.text: Menü Kereső Ott erősíteni, ahol az állami iskola a leggyengébb, ez lehet az evangélikus oktatás jövője Podcast Hobot Péter A közoktatás legnagyobb problémái az általános iskolákban vannak, ezért az evangélikus egyház most már tudatosan erre a területre koncentrál. Általános iskolát is lehetőség szerint körzettel vesznek át. Ez azt jelenti, hogy az adott körzetben élő gyerekeket kötelesek felvenni és oktatni. Itt van a legnagyobb lehetőség is, hiszen az általános iskolákban szorosabb kapcsolat alakítható ki a családokkal, és az egyházak keresik ezt a lehetőséget. A Dirik podcast eheti vendége Kézdy Edit, a Deák Téri Evangélikus Gimnázium igazgatója, aki az általános iskolák mellett abban látja az egyház oktatási stratégiájának jövőjét, hogy alternatív pedagógiai módszereket dolgoznak ki a sajátos nevelési igényű diákok számára, és húsz intézményt bevonó esélyegyenlőségi programot működtetnek a hátrányos helyzetű tanulók támogatására. Emellett saját vezetői értékelési rendszert dolgoztak ki, amelyben többek között a tantestületi légkört és az önértékelést is mérik. „Laboratóriumként működünk” – mondja Kézdy. Az egyházi iskolák igyekeznek a hátrányos helyzetű diákokat is oktatni, arányuk azonban a gimnáziumokban mindössze 1–2 százalék, szemben a teljes közoktatás 2025-ös, mintegy 10 százalékos arányával. Az elmúlt években ugyanis a hátrányos helyzetű diákokat egyre inkább a szakképzés felé terelték. „Minden ember vágyik arra, hogy választ kapjon az élet nagy kérdéseire: Miért vagyok itt? Honnan jöttem? Mi a feladatom? Az ezekről való közös gondolkodás sokak számára vonzó, ahogy az is, hogy a gyerekek egy válogatott, hasonló értékrendű közösségbe kerülnek. Vannak szülők, akik a kiszámíthatóbb, formálisabb rend miatt választják az egyházi iskolákat, az ő elvárásuknak nem feltétlen akar a Deák Téri Evangélikus Gimi megfelelni. Emellett egyfajta tolóerő is megfigyelhető: ahogy az állami gimnáziumok minősége – vagy annak megítélése – romlott, iskolák épültek le, egyre több helyen hiányoznak a szaktanárok, a szülők más iskolákba próbálják vinni gyerekeiket” – magyarázza Kézdy Edit annak okait, hogy az elmúlt 15 évben 35 ezerről 51 ezerre nőtt az egyházi gimnáziumokban tanulók száma. A Deák Téri Gimnáziumban kiemelten fontos a közösségi nevelés. Ahhoz, hogy a gyerekek befogadóak és elfogadóak legyenek, sok közös élményre és együtt töltött időre van szükség: nyári táborokra, erdei iskolára, evezésre, színházlátogatásra, játékdélutánokra és beszélgetésekre. „Egyre inkább azt gondolom, hogy ez az iskola egyik legfontosabb feladata: a szocializáció, a közösségi nevelés. Információhoz ugyanis ma már máshol is könnyen hozzá lehet jutni” – mondja az igazgató. Kézdy Edit szerint az egyházi iskolák nem kapnak többlettámogatást az államtól. A gimnáziumokban nagyjából ugyanannyi diák jut egy tanárra, és a közvetlenül segítő munkatársak száma is hasonló az állami iskolákéhoz. Azonban sok egyházi iskola jelentős infrastrukturális fejlesztéseken ment keresztül, így korszerű, szép épületekben tanítanak. Kézdy szerint ezek a finanszírozási rendszeren kívüli beruházások az evangélikus iskolákat nagyrészt elkerülték. A podcast epizód arról is szól, milyen segítséget nyújthatnak a nevelő-oktató munkát segítő munkatársak, és milyen jó gyakorlatokat lehet átvenni a svéd iskoláktól. Kövess minket Facebookon is! http://www.mexicostar.com/news/279305963.text: NATO military alliance to boost support for Ukraine Mohan Sinha 17 Sep 2026, 08:59 GMT+10 NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte said on September 14 that Russian drone strikes near the Ukraine-Poland border would lead the military alliance to increase its support for Kyiv. Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk warned on September 13 that Russia appeared ready to increase attacks connected to Ukraine’s borders with European countries. The developments have increased concerns among NATO members that Russia’s war against Ukraine could increasingly affect neighboring European countries. WARSAW, Poland: NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte said on September 14 that Russian drone strikes near the Ukraine-Poland border would lead the military alliance to increase its support for Kyiv. He described the attacks as a sign that Russian forces were becoming increasingly desperate. "The strikes yesterday on trains in Ukraine close to NATO territory again show Putin's desperation and also his desire to sow fear and terror," Rutte said at NATO headquarters in Brussels. Rutte said NATO would increase its support for Ukraine and strengthen the defenses of its 32 member countries along the alliance's eastern border with Russia. He also said Russian President Vladimir Putin would not succeed in weakening NATO's unity or stopping its support for Ukraine. Rutte's comments came after Poland announced stronger security measures along its border with Ukraine. The move followed a series of Russian drone attacks near the frontier, including two drones that came down only a few kilometers from Polish territory. Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk warned on September 13 that Russia appeared ready to increase attacks connected to Ukraine's borders with European countries. Ukraine is already facing an intense Russian air campaign involving ballistic missiles and jet-powered drones designed to break through its air defenses. Tusk said the coming weeks and months could bring a major increase in Russian activity. He also warned that the escalation could affect Polish territory. He had issued a similar warning on September 10. Polish Defense Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz said on X that the Polish army had recovered what appeared to be a Russian military drone from the Baltic Sea near the coastal village of Jaroslawiec. Polish officials said intelligence assessments, including information from a CIA briefing the previous week, indicated that Russia could target border areas and increase sabotage operations in European countries. The reported aim would be to discourage Western countries from continuing their support for Ukraine. Tusk said Poland would discuss preparations for a possible joint response with its NATO allies. Polish Foreign Minister Radoslaw Sikorski highlighted NATO's military strength. He said European NATO air forces, even without U.S. involvement, would be capable of destroying half of Russia's oil refineries more quickly than Ukraine could. Deputy Defense Minister Cezary Tomczyk described the latest drone attacks as a serious escalation by Russia. He said any conflict spilling into European countries could involve sabotage, a major increase in hybrid warfare or other hostile actions along NATO's borders. The developments have increased concerns among NATO members that Russia's war against Ukraine could increasingly affect neighboring European countries. Poland, which shares a border with Ukraine and lies on NATO's eastern flank, has been particularly alert to the risk of Russian attacks or other hostile activity crossing into its territory. https://tribune.com.pk/story/2630352/cze.text: Home Sports Czechs conquer USA to reach Davis Cup finals Lehecka seals dramatic victory in Prague as South Korea make history by reaching last eight Jiri Lehecka downed Learner Tien in a deciding rubber as the Czech Republic stunned the United States 3-2 in Davis Cup qualifying for a second straight year, while South Korea reached the last eight for the first time on Saturday. The Czechs knocked out the Americans at the same second qualifying round stage in a deciding rubber in Delray Beach a year ago, when Jakub Mensik beat Frances Tiafoe to secure a surprise victory. Tomas Berdych's men repeated the feat in similarly dramatic fashion, to the delight of a raucous home crowd in Prague, as Lehecka clinched a 6-3, 7-5 win over world number 13 Tien. The USA are record 32-time winners of the competition but their wait for a first title since 2007 goes on. The Czechs advance to the November eight-team finals in Bologna, where hosts Italy will bid for a fourth straight title. "The wins in Davis Cup are always a little bit different because this is a team competition," said Lehecka. After starting the day locked at 1-1, the USA nudged ahead as Christian Harrison and Austin Krajicek saved four match points to outlast Adam Pavlasek and Patrik Rikl in a thrilling 5-7, 6-3, 7-6 (10/8) win. Mensik then fought back from a set down to keep the tie alive by defeating recent US Open runner-up Ben Shelton 5-7, 6-4, 6-3. Shelton took a tense first set after saving a set point when trailing 5-4, reeling off the last three games. Mensik created a set point at exactly the same stage of the second, but this time made no mistake with a booming forehand to level the match. The 21-year-old, a semi-finalist at this year's French Open, forced the tie into a deciding rubber on his second match point in a tense final game. Lehecka, who beat Shelton in straight sets on Friday, recovered after giving an early break back to take the first set. Tien forged 3-0 ahead as he attempted to force the tie all the way to a final set, but fell away and Lehecka clinched a brilliant win on his fourth match point. "I must say it has been a great week. But, most importantly, we made it through as a team. Without Jakub winning against Ben, I would not have the chance to play the final match," added Lehecka. History-making South Korea Earlier, South Korea made history by beating India 3-1 in Seoul. Kwon Soon-woo brushed Sumit Nagal aside 6-1, 6-2 to clinch the decisive point for the Koreans, who won both of Friday's singles rubbers before India triumphed in the doubles. "I feel very proud for my country and every team I play against, I give my best," said Kwon. Austria also booked their spot as Jurij Rodionov sealed a 3-1 win for the hosts in Vienna with a 7-6 (8/6), 6-3 victory over Zizou Bergs, Belgium's number one in the absence of Alexander Blockx. Rodionov got Austria on the board in Friday's opening singles before Bergs pulled Belgium level. Doubles pair Lucas Miedler and Neil Oberleitner then beat Sander Gille and Joran Vliegen in straight sets to put Austria back on top. France kept their tie with Canada alive, as Benjamin Bonzi and Pierre-Hugues Herbert beat Felix Auger-Aliassime and Duncan Chan in straight sets in the second day's opening doubles match to cut their deficit to 2-1. Newly-crowned US Open champion Alexander Zverev gave Germany a 1-0 lead over Croatia in Halle, making a quick return to action as he beat Matej Dodig 6-4, 7-6 (7/3). But Germany, who have not won the Davis Cup since 1993, were pegged back to end the first day level as Croatian youngster Dino Prizmic brushed aside Daniel Altmaier 6-4, 6-3. Spain continued their tilt at a seventh title by seizing a 2-0 lead over Chile in Santiago courtesy of singles wins for Daniel Merida and Davis Cup debutant Rafael Jodar over Alejandro Tabilo and Cristian Garin, respectively. Britain's Toby Samuel overcame Andres Andrade of Ecuador and Wimbledon semi-finalist Arthur Fery saw off Alvaro Guillen Meza as the hosts took a 2-0 advantage in London. https://www.g4media.ro/prefectul-capital.text: Funcționăm ca organizație non-profit, iar banii rezultați din contribuțiile cititorilor sunt destinați integral finanțării proiectului G4Media. Prefectura Capitalei a atacat în instanţa de contencios administrativ şi fiscal hotărârile Consiliului Local Sector 1 prin care a fost încheiat un nou contract de salubritate cu operatorul Blue Planet, potrivit portatului Tribunalului Bucureşti. “Aprobarea studiului de oportunitate si a solutiei de delegare prin concesiune a activitatii de colectare a deseurilor necesita acordul prealabil al Consiliului General al Municipiului Bucuresti. În cazul în care demersul este iniţiat la nivelul unui sector, conform cadrului legal general privind serviciile comunitare de utilităţi publice, respectiv Legea nr. 51/2006, Legea nr. 100/2026 si OUG nr. 57/2019 privind Codul administrativ, competenţa principală în organizarea şi coordonarea serviciului de salubrizare pe intreg teritoriul Bucureştiului revine CGMB”, a arătat Prefectura Capitalei, potrivit unui document consultat de G4Media.ro. În februarie acest an, Consiliul Local al Sectorul 1 a votat în unanimitate proiectul de hotărâre prin care Primarul Sectorului 1 a fost mandatat să informeze compania Romprest Service S.A., Consiliul Concurenței și ANRSC că, la data de 30 iunie 2026, Contractul de delegare a serviciului de salubrizare încetează prin ajungerea la termen. Între timp, Primăria Sectorului 1 a semnat un contract prin încredinţare directă cu un nou operator de salubritate, potrivit unui comunicat al instituției. “Sectorul 1 are de la 1 iulie 2026 un operator de salubrizare pentru perioada de tranziție. Blue Planet va asigura, pentru maximum 12 luni, colectarea deșeurilor menajere, curățenia stradală și deszăpezirea. Contractul cu Romprest încetează la 30 iunie 2026, prin ajungerea la termen. Pentru ca Sectorul 1 să nu rămână fără servicii de salubrizare după această dată, Consiliul Local a aprobat la data de 18 mai 2026 cadrul legal prin care Primăria Sectorului 1 poate atribui un contract de tranziție. Acest contract va acoperi activitățile de salubrizare necesare până la finalizarea licitației deschise pentru colectarea deșeurilor menajere și până la operaționalizarea URBANZOR SRL, societatea cu capital integral public înființată de Consiliul Local pentru curățenia stradală și deszăpezire. Pentru a asigura continuitatea serviciilor publice, procedura folosită pentru alegerea operatorului din perioada de tranziție a fost negocierea fără publicare prealabilă. Legea nr. 98/2016, art. 104 alin. (1) lit. c) permite această variantă atunci când o primărie trebuie să aleagă într-un termen scurt un operator temporar care să asigure curățenia și colectarea deșeurilor într-o comunitate. Economii de 72,5 milioane lei pentru aceleași servicii În urma procedurilor competitive desfășurate în ultimele două săptămâni și a ofertelor de preț depuse de participanți, compania Blue Planet va asigura serviciile de salubrizare în Sectorul 1 pentru o perioadă de maximum 12 luni. Contractul acoperă activitățile de colectare a deșeurilor menajere, curățenia stradală și deszăpezirea. La procedură au participat și companiile de salubrizare REBU și Brantner, dar Blue Planet a avut oferta cu prețul cel mai mic. Astfel, valoarea contractului este de 95,5 milioane lei pentru 12 luni. „De la 1 iulie, Sectorul 1 schimbă operatorul de salubrizare, dar serviciul public continuă. Am folosit procedura legală care permite asigurarea continuității după încetarea contractului cu Romprest. Contractul semnat azi are o valoare de 95,5 milioane lei, față de 168 milioane lei cât ar fi costat aceeași perioadă în vechiul contract. Pe scurt, vom plăti cu 72,5 milioane lei mai puțin”, a declarat viceprimarul Sectorului 1, Iulian Hatmanu. Această perioadă este o etapă preliminară până la intrarea în funcțiune a noului sistem de salubrizare. Primăria Sectorului 1 va urmări în următoarele luni două direcții: – Finalizarea procedurilor legale de licitație deschisă pentru colectarea separată și transportul deșeurilor menajere și similare; – Operaționalizarea URBANZOR SRL pentru curățenia stradală și deszăpezire. Schimbarea operatorului de la 1 iulie 2026 nu introduce taxe suplimentare pentru cetățeni. Taxa pentru colectarea deșeurilor menajere este prevăzută din anul 2027 și se află în etapa de consultare cu asociațiile de proprietari. Această taxă va acoperi strict colectarea, transportul, sortarea, tratarea și eliminarea deșeurilor menajere, iar valoarea ei nu va depăși nivelul taxelor practicate în celelalte sectoare ale Capitalei pentru același tip de serviciu. Curățenia stradală și deszăpezirea vor fi finanțate, ca și până acum, de la bugetul local”, este comunicatul Primăriei Sectorului 1 din data de 10 iunie 2026 prin care a anunţat contractul cu Blue Planet. Încetarea contractului cu Romprest a fost atacată însă în instanţă de operatorul de salubritate , iar primăria Sectorului 1 anunţa în iunie că tranziția către noul operator se amână. ”Tribunalul București a admis astăzi, în parte, cererea formulată de Compania Romprest Service S.A. și a dispus suspendarea provizorie a efectelor actelor prin care contractul de delegare a serviciului de salubritate urma să înceteze, prin ajungere la termen, la data de 30 iunie 2026. În consecință, procesul de tranziție către noul operator, programat pentru data de 1 iulie 2026, se amână până la clarificarea, pe cale judecătorească, a situației contractuale”, arăta Primăria Sectorului 1.
